en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammaad Bin Usman, and Jameel Bin Darraj, from Ismail Bin Abdul Rahman Al Ju’fy,
(The narrator says), ‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying, ‘
The grandfather is apportion as the brothers, whatever (number) they reach, and even if they were a hundred thousand’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman and Jamil ibn Darraj from ’Isma‘il ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman al-Ju‘fiy who has narrated the following: “I once heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
The grandfather distributes the legacy with brothers in equal shares, no matter whatever the number of brothers is.’”
